_comment: Palette skills that the game casts as a different skill id depending on a form. The API publishes the palette skill (the id on the build tab and behind the palette id) with no link to its variants: no flip_skill, transform_skills, bundle_skills or next_chain, and a fact list without damage or conditions. The wiki splits each into a '(non-celestial)' and a '(Celestial Avatar)' page with their ids. `out_of_form` is the id cast outside the form; `in_form` is recorded for the form bar and not read yet. Catalogued 2026-09-23 from the wiki infoboxes (id, palette id) of the six Druid glyphs; other form-dependent palette skills are not catalogued and keep the palette skill.
